A convenient powder room is located on the main level, while two updated full bathrooms add comfort and functionality on the second level. Enjoy the convenience of on-site parking and a prime location just minutes from the Springdale Train Station, shopping, restaurants, and Merritt Parkway, making commuting a breeze. Very low HOA's are an additional perk, making this an exceptional opportunity for homeowners and investors alike seeking affordable, low-maintenance living in a desirable Stamford location. You have found your home sweet home!
